system.description: The Path of the Merciful shows you how to heal the wounded. When you can take a few minutes to focus on the target you're helping, you can spend a Hope to make them clear a Hit Point or a Stress. Once per Rest, when you spend this time learning something new about them or revealing something about al-Musawwir's teachings, you help them clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress instead. You may only affect someone in this way once per Rest.
system.usageNote: Each recipient can benefit once per Rest. Track affected targets in Notes.
